newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Anti-Taleban plane bombs Kabul, no casualties.
newsitem.headline: Anti-Taleban plane bombs Kabul, no casualties.

text.p: A warplane of Afghanistan's anti-Taleban alliance dropped a bomb near Kabul airport in the early hours of Monday, causing no casualties, a Pakistan-based Afghan news service reported.
The Afghan Islamic Press said the bomb landed about two km (1-1/4 miles) southeast of the airport, the apparent target of the raid, setting a timber store ablaze.
Planes belonging to northern opposition leader General Abdul Malik have bombed Kabul three times since Friday, targeting the civil and military airport in the northeast of the city.
The Taleban, who captured Kabul in September, are fighting to impose their strict Islamic rule across Afghanistan, but have failed to quell opposition forces in the north.
